raw_file: raw/papers/1979_Ekström et al_Spin-alignment attenuation factors in mass 61–67 nuclei populated by (α, n) and (α, p) reactions.pdf
scope: PDF 1–2: aim, alpha definitions, pure E2 selection and Table 1 data lineage
PDF 3–4: reactions and MANDY normalization, optical sensitivity, threshold-group residuals
PDF 5–6: feeding and Figure 6, Eq. 5 and Eq. 6, references
evidence_gaps: The data are a compilation of Liverpool angle distributions, and rows with poor alignment constraints were excluded.
Seven of 14 Ni61 rows directly reuse Wadsworth J. Phys. G 3, 35. Two cite private communication and five the separate J. Phys. G 3, 833 paper. No fresh delta or linear polarization.
Alpha_2 prediction error is not a sigma/I prior or universal population uncertainty. The 20% feed example is a calculation.
